About the project

An energetic event website for Crescent CSE, bringing technical and non-technical competitions, schedules, and event information together.

Institution
Crescent Institute · Department of Computer Science and Engineering
Event date
26 October 2026
Role
Built independently by a Webly co-founder
Technology
React · Vite · Tailwind CSS · Vercel
Typical build window
2–3 weeks
Scope
Event website · Information architecture · Responsive design & motion
Website
Open live project

Make sixteen competitions easy to find

Present sixteen competitions without overwhelming visitors. Participants need to discover the right events and quickly find schedules, venues, FAQs, and the people to contact.

Put the practical details beside each event

A strong event identity anchors the homepage. Organised event discovery and supporting information give each competition a place, with practical details accessible across mobile and desktop.

Inside the website

  • Sixteen technical and non-technical competitions

  • Event discovery and individual event information

  • Schedules, venues, and FAQs

  • Coordinator and contact details

One place to plan the day

Participants can browse 16 competitions and find schedules, venues, and coordinator details in one place.

Visual direction

Oversized type, expressive colour, and purposeful motion create the energy of a college event while maintaining a consistent structure for its information.
